evidence.effect: Pre-auction price pressure, 30-year bond, own auction (inverted-V yields around the auction)
evidence.rule: On 30-year bond auction days, short from T_a-180 min to T_a-1 min (T_a = competitive close, 13:00 ET = 12:00 CT); measured in the cash on-the-run 30Y. Post leg: long T_a+0+ to T_a+180 after results.
evidence.conversion: Pre-auction yield change +0.634 bp x D 12 = 7.61 bp of ZB notional = 3.41 ticks at P=140 (range D 11-13: 3.12-3.69 ticks). Upper bound if ZB moved like the on-the-run 30Y: 12.075 bp = 5.41 ticks. Clock-aligned (t2=10:20 CT, h120 to 12:20): about 1.75 ticks full sample (1.56x D8), 1.19 ticks scaled to 2015-2024 (1.06x); h60: 1.14 / 0.77 ticks. ZB tick = 1/32 point = $31.25 on $100,000 face; notional = P x $1,000; ticks = bp x P / 312.5. Price level P = 140 is an ASSUMPTION (no public ZB price was fetched); scale linearly (x0.857 at 120, x1.143 at 160). Yield bp -> ZB price bp uses an ASSUMED ZB (CTD) modified duration D = 12 (range 11-13), inferred from the 15-to-<25-year deliverable grade (CBOT filing saved by the UB reader, pages/UB/cftc_rul052110cbot001.pdf) with the CTD at the short end; not sourced as a number [unverified].
evidence.sample: On-the-run cash 30Y (GovPX 1991-2000, BrokerTec 2001-2024-07), 1-minute, auctions 1991-06-25..2024-07-24; not futures
evidence.decay_evidence: 30Y yield pressure by subsample: 1991-2006 0.394 (ns), 2007-2014 1.448***, 2015-2024 0.592 (ns). Price pressure 2015-2024 14.224* vs 17.106*** full. 30Y post-auction reversal negligible (-0.235 bp, ns; +5.031 bp return, ns). Sample overlaps the search window (E.0 lead ruling R-04: SOURCE-OVERLAP).
evidence.source: Fleming, Liu, Nguyen (2026), 'Intraday Price Pressure and Order Flow Around U.S. Treasury Auctions', FRBNY Staff Report 1188 (Mar 2026, rev. Jul 2026)
evidence.quote: Table 2, 30-Year column: 'Yield Pressure (bps) ... 0.869***'; '∆Y (pre) ... 0.634***'; '∆Y (post) ... −0.235'; 'S3: 2015-2024 ... 0.592'. Table 3, 30-Year: 'Price Pressure (bps) ... 17.106***'; 'Pre-auction Return (bps) ... −12.075***'; 'Post-auction Return (bps) ... 5.031'; 'S3: 2015-2024 ... 14.224*'. Text p.19: 'with the two components broadly similar in magnitude except for the 30-year bond, where the post-auction adjustment is negligible.'
evidence.quote_location: pp.18-21; Table 2 and Table 3 (pp.47-48 of the PDF)

evidence.effect: Post-FOMC yield decline (unconditional) and nulls before FOMC / around payrolls
evidence.rule: After the FOMC statement, yields decline for about 3 hours (all on-the-run maturities); no systematic yield change in the 3 hours before FOMC or employment releases, none after employment.
evidence.hold: up to 180 min after the statement
evidence.conversion: Per-maturity values are in Figure A4 only (not read from text). Range 0.5-1.5 bp yield x D 12 = 6-18 bp over ~3 h; a t4 (14:08 CT) entry to F (15:08) captures minutes +68..+128 only (statement 13:00 CT): linear share 1/3 -> about 2-6 bp = 0.9-2.7 ticks at P=140 [derived, unverified].
evidence.quote: 'In the three hours prior to each announcement, yield changes are not systematically different from zero. Following employment report releases, yield changes remain largely insignificant. FOMC announcements are followed by a significant and persistent decline in yields—on the order of 0.5–1.5 bps—consistent with the previously documented post-FOMC drift in bond markets (Brooks et al., 2018; Indriawan et al., 2021).'

proposed_features.name: k2_auc10_mto_zb (minutes to the 10-year note auction close, on ZB rows)
proposed_features.source: Fleming, Liu, Nguyen (2026), FRBNY SR 1188, Table 4 and p.23
proposed_features.quote: Table 4: '10-Year 1.013∗∗∗ 1.076∗∗∗ 1.259∗∗∗ 0.796∗∗∗ 1.192∗∗∗ 1.294∗∗∗' (30-Year column 1.294); p.23: 'Auctions of 5-, 7-, and 10-year notes are associated with significant yield pressure across the entire curve.'
proposed_features.formula: On a ZB row at decision time t of trade date d: if d is a 10Y auction date (tenor '10Y' in TREASURY_AUCTIONS / EC-AUC) and t < T_a (T_a = auction instant in CT, normally 12:00): value = (T_a - t) in minutes, applicability flag 1; else value 0, flag 0. Same fixed_clock() as k2_auction_mto with AUCTION_TENOR replaced by '10Y' for ZB. Optional msince side (t >= T_a) at t3/t4.
calendars: TREASURY_AUCTION 10Y: EC-AUC 2010-2019 (106 rows in the backward window), frozen release calendar 2019-2024 (59 rows)
proposed_features.derivation: Pre-auction share of the 1.294 bp total assumed 0.55 (bracket 0.37-0.73) -> 0.712 bp over T_a-180..T_a-1 (09:00-12:00 CT). Short at t2 = 10:20 CT with h120 (exit 12:20): 100/180 of the pre leg minus 20/180 of the post reversal = 0.331 bp yield x D 12 = 3.97 bp = 1.78 ticks at P=140 on the 1991-2024 average (bracket 0.94-2.61 ticks); scaled by the 10Y own-auction 2015-2024/full ratio 0.497 -> 0.88 ticks. h60 (10:20-11:20): 1.28 ticks full, 0.63 post-2015. Every step past the 1.294 bp is a derivation; ZB duration and price level are assumptions.
